legal_ref: Ligji nr. 92/2014 'Për tatimin mbi vlerën e shtuar në Republikën e Shqipërisë', i ndryshuar (deri ligji nr. 80/2025), neni 48
quote: Neni 48 Shkalla standarde: Shkalla standarde e tatimit mbi vlerën e shtuar për furnizimet e mallrave dhe shërbimeve, e cila aplikohet si një përqindje e vlerës së tatueshme, është 20 përqind. — The standard VAT rate on supplies of goods and services is 20 percent. (Law 92/2014 'hyn në fuqi më 1 janar 2015')
source_title: Drejtoria e Përgjithshme e Tatimeve — Ligji nr. 92/2014 për TVSH, tekst i përditësuar (amended through Law 80/2025 of 11.12.2025)

reduced_rates.scope: accommodation in tourist structures; supplies in 5-star 'special status' branded hotels/resorts; agritourism accommodation and restaurant (excl. drinks); advertising by audiovisual media; electric public-transport buses; books of all kinds; construction works for sports infrastructure (Art. 49(3)-(9))
agricultural inputs: chemical fertilisers, pesticides, seeds and seedlings (Art. 49(10))
exports and other zero-rated supplies (Chapter on supplies at 0%)

notes: Law 92/2014 in force from 1 January 2015 (Art. final: 'hyn në fuqi më 1 janar 2015'); Albania's 20% rate predates it under the previous VAT law. Agricultural producers' flat-rate compensation 10%. Registration threshold set by separate fiscal legislation (not checked).
unverified: valid_from: 2015-01-01 is the commencement of the current VAT Law 92/2014; the 20% rate applied already under the previous VAT law (start date of 20% under that law not confirmed)
